incidents.name: BunniHub withdraw rounding
incidents.notes: BunniHubLogic.withdraw() rounded the idle-balance update in the wrong direction, so a sequence of precisely sized swaps against the Liquidity Distribution Function shrank a pool's active reserves while burning almost no shares, letting the attacker withdraw more than deposited (Ethereum USDC/USDT leg; the same BunniHub address on Unichain lost a further ~$5.9m in tx 0x4776f31156501dd456664cd3c91662ac8acc78358b9d4fd79337211eb6a1d451).

sources.ref: onchain review: BunniHub 0x0000...65f1 (creator 0xfbe09b7a6c6cc3a72b4ca41cdd9c88ac62bb7937, unrelated to attack sender 0x0c3d8fa7...) is reached through Uniswap v4 PoolManager and BunniHook 0x000052423c1db6b7ff8641b85a7eefc7b2791888 in the attack tx; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events before the incident; the identical Unichain deployment (same address, deployed 2025-06-11) was drained 171 seconds earlier and is omitted here only because scripts/verify.mjs has no chain id for unichain. Recheck (deployment basis confirmed): all 44 DELEGATECALLs the hub makes during the exploit go to 0x000000000dbb048f2e744e4b15b5aeef65e09528 (BunniHubLogic), which appears as a PUSH20 link-time constant in the hub's runtime and so cannot be repointed; keccak(eth_getCode) on the hub is identical at the creation block 22684511 and the incident block 23273098, and neither the EIP-1967 implementation nor the beacon slot is set.
